Title: Elysium: when does one use it?

Messages.Author: Dallas Card
Messages.Body:
According to the new errata, a Methuselah not involved in the current combat can
tap the Elysium to end combat. When can he do this? - since he is neither the
acting nor blocking Methuselah.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


According to the old ruling (not errata), it cannot be used unless
you control one of the combatants

There is no errata, new or old.

--

Elysium: Arboretum, The - Master: Unique Location

* May not be used if you have no minions in the combat.
